name: lodge
description: Local-first delivery workbench for multi-agent rooms, evidence and handoff.
author: Lodge

scripts.package:mac: npm run prepare:runtimes && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.package:mac:dir: npm run prepare:runtimes && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dir --publish never
scripts.package:win: npm run prepare:runtimes && npm run build && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.package:linux: npm run prepare:runtimes && npm run build && electron-builder --linux --publish never
scripts.test: node --test server/crew/*.test.js ui/src/architecture.test.js ui/src/goal-island/*.test.js ui/src/room/*.test.js ui/src/approval-card.test.js ui/src/delivery-sheet.test.js
